findings.title: allowed-tools omits MCP tools used in body
findings.evidence: Frontmatter declares 'allowed-tools: Read Write Edit' but body invokes orbrey:recipes.list (line 58), orbrey:calendar.list (line 59), orbrey:grocery.list (line 60), orbrey:lists.list (line 64), orbrey:lists.create (line 118)
findings.fix: Update frontmatter to enumerate MCP tools: 'allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, mcp__orbrey__recipes_list, mcp__orbrey__calendar_list, mcp__orbrey__grocery_list, mcp__orbrey__lists_list, mcp__orbrey__lists_create' (or appropriate prefix per harness conventions)

findings.title: Single example covers only the happy path
findings.evidence: Only one example file present; skill supports 7/14/28-day windows and lists six edge cases (SKILL.md:147-154) but none are illustrated
findings.fix: Add at least one of: examples/example-28-day.md, examples/example-thin-library.md, examples/example-all-vegetarian.md

findings.title: No paths auto-activation glob declared
findings.evidence: Frontmatter has no 'paths:' field; skill relies entirely on description-match activation
findings.fix: Optional: add paths globs such as ['**/meal-plan-*.md', '**/meal-plans/**'] if you want auto-activation when the user opens a plan file
